description.zh:
主叫侧放音编码，AXB业务时必须设置。必须包含3个场景的编码。按照“B->X,A->X,其他号码->X”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2,3”表示B->X放音编号为1，A->X放音编号为2，其他号码->X放音编号为3。
description.en:
The caller-side ringback tone code. This parameter is required for AXB services. The code must contain codes for 3 scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "B->X, A->X, other numbers->X", separated by commas.

> "1,2,3" indicates that the ringback tone code for B->X is 1, for A->X is 2, and for other numbers->X is 3.

description.zh:
接通后被叫侧放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2”表示A号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为2。
description.en:
The callee-side ringback tone code played after the call is connected. The code must contain codes for 2 scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "A as callee, B as callee", separated by commas.

> "1,2" indicates that the ringback tone code when phone number A is the callee is 1, and the code when phone number B is the callee is 2.

description.zh:
过期时间，单位：秒，取值：

- 0：永不过期。

- 其他数值：传其它数值时，比如60s，分配X号码成功的60秒内，绑定有效，超过60s后，自动解绑。
description.en:
The expiration time. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

- 0: never expires.

- Other values: when you specify another value such as 60, the binding remains valid for 60 seconds after phone number X is assigned. After 60 seconds, the binding is automatically released.
The unique identifier of the message request.

description.zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。不能超过100个字符长度。
description.en: The external business extension field. This parameter is returned in the call record receipt message. The value cannot exceed 100 characters in length.

description.zh: 绑定时间，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制。
description.en: The binding time. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmss. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format.

description.zh:
接通后主叫侧的放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2”表示A号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为2。
description.en:
The caller-side ringback tone code played after the call is connected. The code must contain codes for 2 scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "A as callee, B as callee", separated by commas.

> "1,2" indicates that the caller-side ringback tone code when phone number A is the callee is 1, and the code when phone number B is the callee is 2.

description.zh:
固话AXN分机的A号码。

> A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符。
description.en:
Phone number A of the landline AXN extension.

> Phone number A can be a mobile phone number or a landline number. For landline numbers, include the area code. Do not add a hyphen between the area code and the number.

description.zh: 业务时间戳，格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS，时间采用北京时间，24小时制，精确至毫秒。
description.en: The business timestamp. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format, accurate to milliseconds.

title.en: Update AXN extension number binding relationship
